_README: Content for the inspection graphs: what each prompt is fed when its FTA
is rendered for reading. Keyed '<demo>.<prompt>'; a prompt with no entry
is instantiated with {} and gets the schema's full shape (arrays expanded
to their maximum, every field a generation) instead of one forced path.
CONTENT, not inputs: keyed by the prompt's own field names, after the
channel block has resolved. That is why the strings-* family lists
'choices' (plain texts, pulled through `choices get choice.value`) while
One question, four choices, everywhere. The point is to read the graphs
side by side, so nothing varies here that does not have to.
_question: Deliberately a question whose choices are NOT in a natural order, so a model that answers by position rather than by content is visible.
